digest.component_or_area: store write path - ticket directory creation
propositions: Creating a ticket directory with os.makedirs outside the write lock and writing the first event file inside the lock creates a window where interruption leaves an empty directory that fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH
The same mkdir-then-file vulnerability exists in both single-event and batch write paths, and in reconciler event writing (_write_event_file) and bridge alert emission
Staging directory and first event file must be created together in a staging path and published atomically via a single os.rename operation that occurs under the existing write lock
Dot-prefixed staging path convention (.tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex>) leverages existing fsck scanner exclusions to make temp paths invisible without code changes

Stale staging directories from dead processes must be cleaned up on writer start via bounded best-effort sweep using process ownership stamps (host+pid-namespace+start-time) without touching ticket directories or store data
Concurrent ticket creates of different tickets must produce distinct staging names to avoid collisions while maintaining unchanged lock discipline
